name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix-batch
display_name: Fortinet · Mantis Bug Fix (batch with for_each)
description: Comma-separated list of Mantis bug ids → for each id, runs the full 10-node fortinet-mantis-bug-fix flow (resolve → fix → MR → notify). One pipeline run, N iterations visible in same UI, no child dispatches. Single id behaves identically to single-bug pipeline.
author: forge
